Output kappa_n=<J,B^-1 J>/n, D_n=4kappa_n, is finite-ring zero-frequency scalar response, not a certified approximation to infinite-chain D. Polynomial degree may depend badly on interaction/dephasing ratios; this is not uniform as physical d tends to zero.
